name: Tacos
intro: Chile strips, salsa verde, escabeche, cilantro, lime. Everything on this list came from one shopping trip and two jars.
season_options: Shredded apple slaw with lime and cilantro

variations.ingredients: Chile strips + salsa verde + cilantro + escabeche
variations.context: The September taco. Nothing here is optional.
The vegetable taco that does not feel like a compromise.
The one to make on a weeknight when nothing is defrosted.

works_well_with: Chicken thighs, simmered in salsa verde and shredded
Whatever came in at the fish counter
finish: Warm the tortillas directly over a flame or in a dry pan until they blister in spots, then stack them under a kitchen towel while you set everything else out. Two warm tortillas per taco, not one. That is not excess, it is structural.
